page.heading: Plans designed for every stage of your growth
page.subheading: Transparent pricing. Choose your plan, review at checkout and activate MyChatCRM with the official WhatsApp API.
page.compareSub: Clicking a plan will take you to the secure checkout to complete the subscription (demo).
page.expertSub: Ask about lead limits, integrations, additional WhatsApp numbers (R$ {whatsappExtra}/month each) or migrating your current service.

solo.name: Solo
solo.tagline: Freelancer professional: all tools, with tight limits and the lowest price.
features: Kanban CRM, funnels, AI agents, real-time conversations, lead integrations, collaborators (hierarchy), mass broadcasts, Google Calendar, reminders, integrations (API, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n, etc.), support and reports — with plan limits.
No directors, managers or salespeople — just your account (solo work).
Up to 2 AI agents included (+ additional agents separately).
Unlimited Kanban CRM leads (registration and integrations).
Up to 5 sales funnels in Kanban CRM.
Up to 500 leads served per month (billing count).
Upgrade package on the plans page or with sales.
highlights: AI on WhatsApp with text and audio responses
Solo mode — one account, no team hierarchy
Up to 2 AI agents included (+ extras on the agents page)
Kanban CRM, funnels and conversations with clear monthly limits
Integrations, desktop and support per plan
solo.editorial: For freelance professionals who want the same platform, with usage caps suited to one person.

equipa.name: Team
equipa.tagline: Small teams with commercial hierarchy and higher volume.
features: Kanban CRM, funnels, AI agents, real-time conversations, lead integrations, collaborators (hierarchy), mass broadcasts, Google Calendar, reminders, integrations (API, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n, etc.), support and reports — with plan limits.
Up to 1 director, 3 managers and 30 salespeople.
Unlimited Kanban CRM leads (registration and integrations).
Up to 12 sales funnels in Kanban CRM.
Up to 5,000 leads served per month (billing count).
highlights: AI-powered WhatsApp service, available all the time
AI training supervised by experts
Text and audio responses
Forms and client context capture
Integrations with APIs and external systems
Desktop application for your team
equipa.editorial: The MyChatCRM core: trainable AI, voice, integrations and desktop for teams that want fast, consistent responses.

escala.name: Scale
escala.tagline: Operation with multiple levels and higher service volume.
features: Kanban CRM, funnels, AI agents, real-time conversations, lead integrations, collaborators (hierarchy), mass broadcasts, Google Calendar, reminders, integrations (API, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n, etc.), support and reports — with plan limits.
Up to 5 directors, 25 managers and 30 salespeople.
Unlimited Kanban CRM leads (registration and integrations).
Up to 25 sales funnels in Kanban CRM.
Up to 15,000 leads served per month (billing count).
highlights: Everything the Team plan offers
Full and customizable Kanban CRM for sales
Calendar, events and automatic reminders
Mass broadcasts and segmented campaigns
Team hierarchy (management, leadership and sales)
Extended capacity for higher volume operations
escala.editorial: Designed for operations that need Kanban CRM, commercial rhythm and heavy automation — without giving up the same powerful AI on WhatsApp.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.tagline: Dedicated account under contract — package and limits defined with sales, tailored to the client.
highlights: Dedicated account with negotiated contract package
Limits and deliverables aligned to the client's profile — no fixed catalog
Commercial conversation to design scope, pricing and timeline
enterprise.editorial: For operations that close volume, integrations and conditions directly with sales — each proposal is unique and does not follow the public list of other plans.
